short_description: An AI agent that automatically builds AI models from task descriptions and data, ranked #1 on OpenAI MLE-Bench. It automates the entire machine learning workflow: task analysis, model design, code generation, training, hyperparameter tuning, evaluation, and iterative improvement.
approved_facts: AIBuildAI Agent 2.0 achieved #1 on OpenAI's MLE-Bench with a score of 70.7%, substantially outperforming agents ranked 2nd through 5th.

The agent automatically builds AI models by running an iterative loop: analyzes the task, designs neural network architectures, generates implementation code, trains models, tunes hyperparameters, evaluates performance, and iteratively improves results.
On the TGS Salt Identification Challenge (Kaggle), models automatically developed by AIBuildAI ranked in the top 5.7% among 3,219 expert teams, demonstrating top-tier human expert-level performance.
On the Heart Disease Prediction competition (Kaggle), AIBuildAI-developed models ranked in the top 6.6% among 4,370 expert teams.

AIBuildAI requires a Linux x86_64 machine and uses the Anthropic Claude API (specifically tested with claude-opus-4-6 in examples). Users set credentials via the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable.

The agent accepts two key inputs: a task description (natural-language markdown file) and a data directory containing training/validation/test data. It outputs trained model checkpoints, a standalone inference.py script, and a progress.pdf report.

Supported problem types include: multi-class classification (e.g., enzyme EC number prediction with 7 classes), binary classification (e.g., passenger transport prediction), image segmentation (e.g., wound segmentation for medical imaging, salt identification), and tabular data analysis.

Example tasks in the repository include: protein-ec-prediction (enzyme classification), wound-segmentation (binary medical image segmentation using deep CNNs), spaceship-titanic (tabular classification), tgs-salt-identification-challenge (seismic image segmentation), playground-series-s6e2 (heart disease prediction), aerial-cactus-identification (image classification), and learning-agency-lab-automated-essay-scoring-2 (NLP task).

AIBuildAI evaluates performance using task-specific metrics: F1-score (macro) for multi-class protein classification, Dice coefficient for medical image segmentation, classification accuracy for tabular prediction tasks.

The system generates multiple model candidates during each run (configurable via --num-candidates), automatically selects the best performer, and outputs a standalone inference.py script that can run predictions on new data without the agent.

Command-line interface supports parameters like --max-agent-calls (limit iterations), --run-budget-minutes (wall-clock time budget), --pipeline-budget-minutes (total budget), --model (LLM choice), and interactive TUI mode via the aibuildai command.
Version 1.0 and 2.0 both ranked #1 on MLE-Bench; version 2.0 introduced substantial technical advancements over version 1.0 and is available to Pro users.
Published research paper: arXiv 2604.14455, 'AIBuildAI: An AI Agent for Automatically Building AI Models' by Ruiyi Zhang, Peijia Qin, Qi Cao, Li Zhang, and Pengtao Xie.
The project is MIT-licensed and available on GitHub at github.com/aibuildai/AI-Build-AI. It includes seven pre-configured task examples with real-world datasets and detailed evaluation scripts.
